Signs of the World

No entry

History

The 1968 Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals specifies two versions, a red disc with a white bar and another with a crossed-out arrow.

Adoption

A red disc with a white bar is the standard around the world, from Germany and Denmark to China, Japan and South Korea. The sign is familiar even with minor color changes or added words.

Sources

  • UN: Convention on Road Signs and Signals (Annex 4)
